specifications.statement: 3U chassis form factor. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]
Table 12-2 height 13.3cm/5.25in and depth 70.6cm/27.8in. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]
Table 12-2 width 43.7cm/17.19in; weight literal 16.36kg/96lbs is inconsistent and must remain uncorrected. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]
100–127VAC for 2 CPUs; 200–240VAC for 2 or 4 CPUs, exact CPU condition retained. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]
1837VA@240VAC, 0.98P.F., retain source scope/units. Power-dissipation note describes maximum PSU rating, not actual appliance consumption. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]
Max heat output: 6143BTU/hr, same power-dissipation/PSU-rating note applies. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]
Maximum AC RMS 12A@100VAC / 12A@200VAC. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]
Nominal frequency 50/60Hz. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]

Power Dissipation list says Max power consumption: 1800W, qualified by note that listed dissipation numbers are maximum PSU rating, not actual appliance consumption. [Original HTML article; Sun ZFS Storage 7420 scope]

Attached storage: one to six chains; each chain contains up to six HDD-only or SSD-capable disk shelves, combined in any order. No shelf/cable model or wiring topology is stated here. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-6D3F47EA-7D39-46CC-B484-3CC3BF6671DB; article paragraphs 1]

Fan-module fault indications: front/rear Service Action Required LEDs, front Fan Module Service Action Required (TOP) LED, and Fan Fault LED on/adjacent to faulty module. System Overtemp LED might also light if temperature rises. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 37,39,40,41,42]

Two fan power boards are FRUs; power fan modules, carry status LEDs and transfer I2C fan-module data. Two refers to boards, not fan-module quantity. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 19]

Documented configuration/cluster rule in dated OS8.8.x manual, not installed-unit inventory: Two system boot drives in slots 0 and 1 form a mirrored pair; up to four read-optimized cache SSDs can populate slots 2–5 in order. In a Sun ZFS Storage 7420 clustered configuration, both controllers SSD counts must match. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 22]

Six-drive backplane is a FRU with drive connectors, I/O-board interconnect, Power/Locator buttons and status LEDs; this is not an installed-drive count. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 20]

Vertical PDB Card, also called vertical power distribution board or Paddle Card, is a FRU interconnecting PDB with fan power boards, hard-drive backplane and I/O board. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 17]

Power Distribution Board is a FRU: distributes main 12V from supplies; connects to Vertical PDB, motherboard bus bar/ribbon cable and top-cover interlock kill switch. power supplies → power supply backplane → power distribution board topology is explicitly described. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 16]

Power Supply Backplane Card connects the PDB to power supplies 0 and 1. These are named connection positions; no PSU model, rating or redundancy inference is supplied. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 18]

SP subsystem controls host power and monitors host events. SP controller uses host 3.3V standby rail whenever AC input is present, even when system is off. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 15]

specifications.statement: All installed PSU/fan tray modules must match F2B or B2F airflow; labels indicate direction. [PDF p. 1]
8.382 kg (18.52 lb), with two installed PSUs, five fan trays and two 40G modules; not empty weight. [PDF p. 2]
Kit contains two brackets and eight screws. [PDF p. 1]
Operating 0–40°C; separate storage -40–70°C. [PDF p. 2]
Operating humidity 5–95%, non-condensing. [PDF p. 2]
Two-person rack installation requirement. [PDF p. 1]
Install one or two universal AC modules; up to two PSUs matching installed fan-tray airflow. [PDF p. 1]
PSU AC Input Rating: 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, 6.0-3.0 A. [PDF p. 2]
Switch Power Consumption: 375 Watts maximum, 267 Watts typical; not PSU output. [PDF p. 2]
DCSS serial setup: 115200 bps, 8 characters, no parity, one stop bit, 8 data bits, no flow control; preserve the printed repeated 8-character/8-bit wording. [PDF p. 2]
Literal 6700/6701-32X-D*-******** pattern has switch software pre-loaded; wildcard pattern is not expanded into SKUs. [PDF p. 1]
Literal 6700/6701-32X-O-******** pattern has ONIE installer pre-loaded but no switch software image. [PDF p. 1]
ONIE: network-server installer uses Mgmt RJ-45 with Cat5/5e or better; connection not required for installer on attached storage. [PDF p. 2]
Subsequent boots bypass ONIE and run loaded NOS, per historical guide. [PDF p. 2]
4+1 redundant, hot-swappable fans.
All ports on front; PSUs and fans on rear.
Supports hot/cold aisle with port-to-power and power-to-port airflow SKUs.
Up to 32 x 40GbE ports in compact 1RU form factor.
All ports on front; PSUs and fans on rear.
Energy Efficiency: 267 W typical power consumption.
Hot-swappable, load-sharing, redundant AC or -48V DC PSUs.
